root_cause: The initial worker publication loop had no durable checkpoint between List mutation and channel delivery, and aborted the whole loop on an individual delivery failure. A delayed notification could repeat old status writes and block unrelated results.
fix_summary: Persist List-update completion separately from message delivery, retain per-job delivery errors, continue unrelated publication and task execution, and omit empty PR writes. Reproduced during pre-publication independent review, before live activation.
